annotation.evidence_span: NOT exceed the current RTT estimate or the value it indicates in the max_ack_delay transport parameter
annotation.interpretation_a: The timer must not exceed both the current RTT estimate and the max_ack_delay value (i.e., timer <= min(RTT, max_ack_delay)).
annotation.interpretation_b: The timer must not exceed either the current RTT estimate or the max_ack_delay value, but not necessarily both, allowing the timer to be <= one of them while exceeding the other.
annotation.justification: The clause uses “or” without clarifying whether both constraints apply, leading to two materially different implementation behaviours.
